items.title: Desktop Integration
items.description: Bringing PlayCrew to desktop.

items.title: Add Music Integration for Dashboard
items.description: Allow users to control playcrew playlist straight from dashboard.

items.title: Remaster Background Wallpapers
items.description: Allow users to change their site wallpaper from Site Settings instead of profile for a better user experience.

items.title: Additional Dashboard Backgrounds
items.description: Expand the collection of dashboard backgrounds.

items.title: Enhance Fonts
items.description: Add additional fonts and modify current selection.

items.title: More Themes (General)
items.description: Add additional themes and personalization options.

items.title: Sesonal Themes
items.description: Themes designed for seasonal events (Halloween, Christmas, etc...)

items.title: Higher Quality Background Images/Videos
items.description: Improve the quality of background images and videos for a better visual experience.

items.title: Early Access Games
items.description: Allow users to mark games as Early Access with a dedicated badge displayed on covers. Unlocking games earlier than their release date.

items.title: About Page
items.description: Explain what PlayCrew is, showcase the music playlist, add developer information, contact details, and IGDB credits.

items.title: Custom Domain
items.description: Exploring the possibility of moving PlayCrew to its own dedicated domain and brand identity.

items.title: Dedicated Music Hosting
items.description: Host music files directly on faster servers instead of relying on file hosted music.

items.title: Improved Image Storage
items.description: Improve image storage and retrieval for better performance and reliability.

items.title: Storage Architecture Improvements
items.description: Enhance the storage architecture for better scalability and efficiency.

items.title: Custom Database Infrastructure
items.description: Implement a custom database infrastructure for improved performance and flexibility.

items.title: New Name & Branding
items.description: Consider rebranding PlayCrew with a new name and visual identity.

items.title: Search Modal Redesign
items.description: Allow adding games directly to Want To Play instead of opening the edit modal.

items.title: Improve Authentication Loading Experience
items.description: Prevent protected pages from briefly displaying logged-out content while authentication is still loading by introducing proper loading states and route guards.

items.title: System Tray Integration
items.description: Integrate PlayCrew with the system tray for quick access and notifications.

items.title: Auto Start
items.description: Enable PlayCrew to start automatically when the system boots up.

items.title: Background Notifications
items.description: Implement background notifications for important updates and alerts.

items.title: Background Update Downloads
items.description: Allow PlayCrew to download updates in the background for a seamless user experience.
